title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 19: the potter's earthen container, the valley of the son of Hinnom, the valley of Slaughter, and the broken vessel.

questions.text: What was Jeremiah told to buy at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Go, and buy a potter's earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people, and of the elders of the priests."

answers.text: A potter's earthen container
A belt of fine linen
A field in the land of Anathoth
A yoke of wood and bars

questions.text: Where was Jeremiah told to go and proclaim the words Yahweh would tell him?
questions.explanation: He was to go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words Yahweh would tell him.

answers.text: To the court of the king's house
To the brook Kidron
To the valley of the son of Hinnom
To the gate of Benjamin

questions.text: What will happen to the ears of whoever hears of the evil Yahweh will bring on this place?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle."

answers.text: They will be stopped up
They will tingle
They will be deaf to it
They will burn with shame

questions.text: What did the people do at the high places of Baal that never entered Yahweh's mind?
questions.explanation: They built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which Yahweh did not command or speak, and which did not enter His mind.

answers.text: They sacrificed unclean animals on the altars
They made a covenant with the kings of Egypt
They set up a carved image in the house of Yahweh
They burned their children in the fire as burnt offerings to Baal

questions.text: What will this place be called instead of Topheth or The Valley of the son of Hinnom?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says the days come that this place will no more be called Topheth or The Valley of the son of Hinnom, but "The valley of Slaughter".

answers.text: The valley of Bones
The valley of Slaughter
The valley of Decision
The valley of Weeping

questions.text: What will Yahweh give the dead bodies of Judah and Jerusalem to be?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says He will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

answers.text: Food for the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth
A heap of ruins in the middle of the city
Dust scattered on the high mountains
A burnt offering on the altars of the high places

questions.text: What does Yahweh say the people will eat in the siege and in the distress?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says He will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and each will eat the flesh of his friend in the siege.

answers.text: The bread of affliction and water of adversity
Roots and wild herbs of the field
The grain stored in the king's houses
The flesh of their sons, daughters and friends

questions.text: What was Jeremiah to do with the container in the sight of the men who went with him?
questions.explanation: He was to break the container in their sight and say that Yahweh will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter's vessel, that can't be made whole again.

answers.text: Fill it with water and pour it out
Bury it in the valley
Break it
Set it on the altar

questions.text: What had been done on the roofs of the houses of Jerusalem that defiled them?
questions.explanation: The houses will be defiled like Topheth, because on their roofs they burned incense to all the army of the sky and poured out drink offerings to other gods.

answers.text: Incense to the army of the sky and drink offerings to other gods
The blood of innocent children was shed on them
Altars of Baal were built and then torn down there
Idols of silver and gold were stored and hidden there

questions.text: Where did Jeremiah stand when he came back from Topheth to speak to all the people?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah came from Topheth, where Yahweh had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of Yahweh's house and spoke to all the people.

answers.text: On the city wall
In the court of Yahweh's house
At the gate Harsith
In the king's palace
